Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning changes in the point of a diversion under a surface water right permit.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to changes in the point of diversion under asurface water right permit; and amending RCW 90.03.397.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 90.03.397 and 1999 c 232 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department may approve a change of the point of diversionprescribed in a permit to appropriate surface water for a beneficialuse to an approved intake structure with capacity to transport theadditional diversion to either: (a) A point of diversion that islocated downstream ((and is an existing approved intake structure withcapacity to transport the additional diversion)); or (b) to a point ofdiversion located between Columbia river miles 215.6 and 292, if theownership, purpose of use, season of use, and place of use of thepermit remain the same. (2) This section may not be construed as limiting in any mannerwhatsoever other authorities of the department under RCW 90.03.380 orother changes that may be approved under RCW 90.03.380 under p. 1 SB 5635authorities existing before July 25, 1999.
